strongest_result.statement: Under (2E+1)(t+1)<n, the number of reflection planes of defect at most E is at most max(15,2t+2); under (6E+1)(t+1)<n, the common-direction branch is coaxial apart from the single possible KKPR exception.
strongest_result.q2_boundary: No improvement of the 3/5 exponent and no medium-defect energy bridge.

934.failure_boundary: D>=11r is impossible because D<sqrt(2)r in the target range.
